prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. This is one DRAMATIC COMIC ACTION PANEL filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge (full-bleed, no border): bold dynamic composition, big flat paper speed-line strips, kid-friendly and funny, never scary. Cute, round, friendly Korean picture-book characters for 3-4 year olds: big round white paper eyes with dark pupils, small pink cheek circles, simple rounded shapes, never scary. CRASH! Four different animals — a grey donkey, ONE single small dog (just one dog), a golden cat and a white rooster — tumble in through a window in a funny heap, each animal appears exactly once, big paper glass-shard shapes and a starburst, warm lamp light. EXACTLY FOUR animals appear in the picture: ONE donkey, ONE dog, ONE cat and ONE rooster — there is only ONE dog. The donkey: a cute gentle grey donkey made of flat paper pieces — a lighter grey belly, two long upright ears, a long snout with a pale muzzle, black hooves, a thin tail with a dark tuft, bright round eyes, pink cheeks. The dog: a small SLIM LEAN terrier-mix dog made of flat paper pieces, designed from the reference photo — a slender small dog with a compact short body, a slender chest, LONG THIN LEGS, a medium-size head with a NARROW muzzle and LARGE ears; NOT a corgi, NOT a stubby short-legged long-bodied dog, not chubby, not a puppy-blob. Cream-white body, chest, muzzle and face; the face is entirely cream-white with NO colored patch around either eye (at most a very faint tan wash beside the eyes). The dog's two ears are DIFFERENT: one ear is SOLID tan-orange paper that is HALF-FOLDED, its upper part bending over so the tip flops down; the OTHER ear is white paper with a pink inside and a few small yellow-tan paper spots dotted on its outer side. The dog tumbles, but its ears stay different: never two matching ears. A black nose, bright dark round eyes, small pink cheeks, pink tongue. A plain dog with NO clothes, NO harness, NO vest and NO collar — just bare fur. Same dog in every picture, never brown all over, never both ears orange, never both ears plain white. The cat: a cute golden-yellow cat made of flat paper pieces — three persimmon-orange tabby stripes on its back, pointed ears with pink insides, a small pink nose, short whiskers, a tall upright tail, bright round eyes, pink cheeks. The rooster: a cute round white rooster made of flat paper pieces — a red comb of three round bumps, a red wattle, a small golden beak, a cream wing, a fan of tail feathers in red, gold and brown (no green), golden legs, bright round eyes.  Colour mood: gentle picture-book night — mid-tone blues, a cream moon, warm amber window light, soft sage hills, low saturation. IMPORTANT BRIGHTNESS: even though it is a night or dark scene, render it as a BRIGHT, clearly readable picture-book night — mid-tone blues and warm lamp or moon light lighting everything, all shapes and colours easy to see; never near-black, never murky. No text anywhere. Full-bleed illustration, no lime green.
